validator_contract.security_scope: Descriptor-based O_NOFOLLOW path traversal for file inputs; Git bare cache tree rejects symlinks, external stores, promisor objects and non-allowlisted config. validator_contract.privacy: Structured errors expose fixed codes and bounded component IDs, not exception text, command stderr or absolute private paths. CLI misuse similarly avoids echoing caller arguments.
